content_of_post_to_comment:
i just started student teaching, but student teaching isn't paid so i still gotta have a job. thank you education system! :)

here's what my days look like with my must-do's:

sunday: meal prep, groceries, homework
monday: student teaching 7:30-3, work 6-10
tuesday: student teaching 7:30-3, class 4:30-7:20
wednesday: student teaching 7:30-3, work 6-10
thursday: student teaching 7:30-3, class 4:30-7:20
friday: class 8-5, work 6-10
saturday: work 10-6

work is not guaranteed on all of those days, but it's the most hours i can be expected to work in a week. before student teaching, i worked full time and also made time to take 11k steps a day + gym 4x/week.

how can i keep finding time to exercise regularly while ALSO being motivated to stick to it? i feel like the overwhelming feeling of life makes me lean into junk food every day, and i get too lazy to go to the gym. how do you stay productive and healthy when your schedule is so packed? how do you keep going when life feels too difficult?
